description: Source code implementing feedback mechanisms for USB and I2S synchronization on Nordic nRF53 hardware, including timer and GPIO configurations, PI control, and feedback processing.

methods.name: feedback_edge_counter_setup
methods.description: Configures GPIO and timer for edge counting feedback method.

methods.name: feedback_relative_timer_setup
methods.description: Configures timer for relative timing feedback method.

methods.name: feedback_init
methods.description: Initializes feedback context and hardware timers, sets up GPIOTE and PPI channels.

methods.name: update_sof_offset
methods.description: Calculates and updates the offset between USB SOF and I2S frame start.

methods.name: offset_to_correction
methods.description: Converts offset to correction value for feedback adjustment.

methods.name: pi_update
methods.description: Performs PI control algorithm to generate feedback correction.

methods.name: feedback_process
methods.description: Processes feedback by capturing timer values and updating feedback state.

methods.name: feedback_reset_ctx
methods.description: Resets feedback context to default state.

methods.name: feedback_start
methods.description: Starts feedback process, setting initial offsets based on queued I2S blocks.
